title: Puthoff floats a joint space program

tellings.quote: I was like is it is it their program you know is it the NHI program or is it our program and he goes what if it's a joint space program

plain: Asked whether a secret programme was run by NHI, short for non-human intelligence, or by humans, a man named Hal Puthoff is said to have answered: "what if it's a joint space program". A guest who goes by the name UAPGerb tells Michels this as an exchange he had with Puthoff himself in the 2020s. If true, it would mean humans and non-humans are working together on space travel in secret.
